# agentgateway_llm_virtual_model (Resource)

Manages an `llm.virtualModel`: one client-facing model name routed across concrete models by weight, priority or request conditions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Split traffic between two concrete models by relative weight.
resource "agentgateway_llm_virtual_model" "weighted" {
  name = "smart"

  weighted {
    targets {
      model  = "gpt-4o-primary"
      weight = 90
    }

    targets {
      model  = "gpt-4o-fallback"
      weight = 10
    }
  }
}

# Prefer the lower priority group and fail over when a model degrades.
resource "agentgateway_llm_virtual_model" "failover" {
  name = "resilient"

  failover {
    targets {
      model    = "claude-primary"
      priority = 0
    }

    targets {
      model    = "claude-backup"
      priority = 1
    }
  }
}

# Select a target by request context. The final target may omit `when`; it is
# the fallback when no expression matches.
resource "agentgateway_llm_virtual_model" "conditional" {
  name = "adaptive"

  conditional {
    targets {
      model = "openai-fast"
      when  = "request.headers[\"x-tier\"] == \"free\""
    }

    targets {
      model = "openai-smart"
      when  = "request.headers[\"x-tier\"] == \"pro\""
    }

    targets {
      model = "openai-smart"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Public model name clients request.

### Optional

- `conditional` (Block List) Select a target by request context. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditional))
- `failover` (Block List) Prefer lower priority groups and fail over when a model degrades. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--failover))
- `weighted` (Block List) Split traffic between targets by relative weight. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--weighted))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stored id, derived from `name`.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the stored resource; `0` in file mode.

Optional:

- `targets` (Block List) Models selected by CEL `when` expressions; the final target may omit `when` as the fallback. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditional--targets))

Optional:

- `when` (String) CEL expression selecting this target. May be omitted only on the final target.
